title: NHAMCS emergency department records with Lyme or Long COVID listed, 2016-2022
definition: ED visit records with A69.2x or U09.9 in any of the 5 diagnosis fields.
method: Counted matching records across 123,040 sampled ED visits, 7 survey years.
source_locator: NHAMCS ED public files: DIAG1-DIAG5, PATWT
comparability: Far below the 30-record reliability floor, so no national estimate is given.
Absence here says the survey is too small to see these conditions, not that they are rare.
summary: Only 1 Lyme and 5 Long COVID records among 123,040 sampled ED visits, 2016-2022: too few for any estimate.
how_to_use: Explains why the ED survey cannot support Lyme or Long COVID ED counts; context only.
